notes: Universitywide and NUpath requirements are referenced but not fully expanded.
Placement substitutions, open elective ranges, grade policies and reuse restrictions require individual review.
C-or-higher thresholds apply to named SLPA, math/statistics and supporting science courses. Students must use general electives for unfulfilled NUpath requirements.
Semester-hour units are explicit in the catalog. Published degree totals and category allocations are source rules, not calculated inventory sums.
Course categories are editorial. Source-stated outcomes are paraphrased program aims, not measured graduate outcomes.
The local curriculum is represented; the degree remains partial because full universitywide and conditional policy execution has not been established.
